message: URGENT: Legal notice issued by Cyber Crime Branch. A parcel containing illegal drugs was linked to your phone number. Click http://digital-court-summons.com to join digital custody immediately.

Digital Warrant Issued: Cyber Cell Kolkata has put you under digital house arrest. Submit your identification card and live location immediately.

Sir, police team is waiting outside your city sector. If you want to settle this digital arrest case quietly, send ₹200,000 security bond right now.
